profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Andromeda Systems Incorporated
profile.summary:
I am committed to creating more elegant and accessible web solutions! For more than 20 years, I’ve designed and built websites and web applications with a focus on cross-browser compatibility.

From the days when Netscape was the dominant browser, through the Internet Explorer years, to today, when there are many standards-based browsers to choose from, my goal is to ensure what I build works in them all.

I’m passionate about making sure that whatever I work on is the best it can be, exceeds expectations and adds value for the business and its customers. Whether it’s building a brand-new website, converting a legacy IE only quirks-mode application to modern standards, or leading an automation development test team to develop and maintain an automation test framework, I enjoy the challenge.

Over the course of my career, I’ve been recognized as a subject matter expert in front-end development and commended for my ability to quickly learn new frameworks, concepts and tools. 

Skills:
•	C#
•	ReqnRoll (SpecFlow)
•	Cucumber / Gherkin
•	Selenium WebDriver / Grid
•	NUnit
•	HTML
•	CSS / SCSS / Less CSS
•	ASP.Net Web Forms / MVC / Razor
•	Angular
•	TypeScript	
•	JavaScript
•	Git / GitHub / TFS
•	Visual Studio / VS Code
